TYPE CHECK: The candidate value is a numeric count, which is the correct category for technical_replicates.
SOURCE CHECK: The paper states "each sample was measured in triplicate in DDA and DIA mode", but this refers to the overall measurement of the five spike-in states.
TRUTH CHECK: The text says "the described five spike-in states were measured in triplicates to reflect a common replicate number, resulting in 15 LC-MS/MS runs per method." In proteomics, when samples are prepared and then measured in triplicate, these are typically biological replicates unless specified as technical replicates of a single preparation. The text does not explicitly define these as "technical replicates" (re-runs of the same digest); rather, it describes them as replicates of the "spike-in states."
COMPLETENESS CHECK: The full set contains only this value.
